title: Synopsys, Inc.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Synopsys is the largest EDA vendor by revenue, holding a near-duopoly with Cadence. Their acquisition of ANSYS deepens their exposure to system-level simulation (electronics + physical). They are a primary beneficiary of the custom silicon trend, as companies like Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta use Synopsys tools to design their in-house AI chips.

Future Tech Roadmap

Agentic RTL Verification Confident 2026
📈 Synopsys.ai is the industry's first full-stack AI-driven EDA suite, directly tackling verification bottlenecks.
Chiplet / Disaggregated Architecture Confirmed Ongoing
📈 Synopsys provides the UCIe IP and simulation tools required for the massive industry shift toward chiplet-based designs.
